purpose: Generic contract for canonical identity, per-user authority, per-device session binding and safe cross-surface operation across Desktop, browser, laptop and mobile.

canonical_control_plane.rule: All surfaces use the canonical server-side auth session and short-lived surface/device handoff; no direct token or cookie extraction.

identity_invariants: Every request resolves to exactly one authenticated principal or is rejected.
Registry/declaration is not capability, liveness, authority or routability.
principal_id, tenant_id/domain_scope, surface_id and device binding are read back from the authoritative runtime.
A client-supplied user_id never overrides broker-derived identity.
User data, session stores, graph authority and writer grants are isolated per principal/tenant.
Legacy identity mapping is explicit and allowlisted; unknown subject forms fail closed.

desktop.auth: authenticated internal transport plus broker handoff
desktop.status: Morten verified; implementation is in Hermes Desktop; multi-user onboarding pending

laptop.model: browser or Desktop contract; never a separate credential plane
laptop.status: Morten browser/session path verified; device-specific onboarding pending

mobile.model: canonical browser session or a native client implementing the same handoff/readback contract

user_onboarding_gate: writer capability grant only after owner approval and target pre-read
read-after-write and rollback receipt for every mutation

runtime_layers.mwp: gate, provenance, owner approval, pre-read, receipt, rollback and closeout contract
runtime_layers.hermes_desktop: authenticated transport and metadata-only readback implementation
runtime_layers.box14_broker: 2FA/session verification, subject mapping, surface/device bindings and provenance
runtime_layers.box12_unified_api: authority-gated deterministic actions and Neo4j writer

write_policy.scope: No graph, Symbiose, Obsidian or steward write is generalized merely because a user is logged in.

evidence.morten_graph_receipt: bounded User(morten)-AUTHORED-Theory(Energy-Flow Cosmology) write and read-after-write PASS
evidence.generic_runtime: contract defined; Joakim and native mobile require separate runtime receipts

next_action: Onboard Joakim through this gate and run read-only Desktop/browser/mobile surface smoke tests; do not reuse Morten Home, sessions, cookies or writer authority.
